title: Double-Sided Retail Gondola Bay
description: One original empty freestanding double-sided retail gondola bay. An integral grounded central spine has three uprights, two broad fore-aft feet, solid back panels and full-width cross rails. Three closed shelf decks face each of two opposite aisles, each with a raised outside stop lip and two finite triangular under-brackets. Every bracket has a full vertical seat on the central back panel and a full horizontal support face split between its deck and rail, without hidden overlap. Nineteen closed editable material meshes, three opaque untextured PBR materials. Metres, Z up, centred on the grounded spine and feet. Newly authored complete store fixture, not a second copy of a bookcase, the bakery slatted rack, a mesh-tray hinge drying rack, or a pallet rack scaled/recoloured. Fixed empty appearance only: no stock, adjustable shelf mechanism, load or tipping certification, installation standard, aisle-clearance certification or compatibility claim.
